title: helianthemum pilosum var. asperum
intro: Helianthemum pilosum var. asperum, commonly known as Rough Rockrose, is a perennial shrub that belongs to the family Cistaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Rough Rockrose are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, exhibit anti-cancer properties, and exhibit sedative effects. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum pilosum var. asperum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
